statement: Every tracked file under scripts/ is reachable from a root that runs it - package.json, a workflow, a hook, a gate manifest, the solver, or the probe of an open quest or epic - through the closure of imports and literal mentions; everything outside that closure is deleted (git keeps it), together with the tests and documentation that existed only to exercise it; the quest-evidence receipt harnesses that survive live under scripts/quest-evidence/ so the convention stops growing the loose-file count; and npm run commands plus the generated tools index remain the only catalogue.

constraints.statement: The probe is a mode on the existing unused-files gate owner; the quest adds no script and no workflow.
Reachability starts only from surfaces that run scripts; a mention in prose, a closed quest, or a closed epic keeps nothing alive.
Unreachable scripts are deleted from the tree, never moved to an attic directory or excluded from the census.
The loose-file, total-lines and checks-files budgets of the epic are read after each attempt and never raised.
